ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of childcare fraud cases to identify patterns and connections between entities.
questions: What are the most common methods used to commit childcare fraud?
How much money is being lost to childcare fraud each year?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of childcare fraud cases, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that can inform future investigations and prevention efforts.
